clues.1: Where shadows gather near the highest wall, search beneath the cold stone to unearth your relic piece.
clues.2: Follow the silent corridor toward the mirrored hall. Look where stillness meets forgotten wood.
clues.3: In the chamber of silent tomes, seek beneath the lowermost shelf to recover your squad's crest.
clues.4: Near the threshold where dusk breaks, examine the base of the sentinel pillar.
clues.5: Where two secret pathways converge, the relic shard rests hidden in plain sight.
clues.6: Look where the royal tapestry hangs. The secret passage conceals the hidden token.
